resources.string: Everything runs on your phone. No internet, no accounts, no message bodies stored.
Lets SpamShield check each incoming call and silence or reject the ones that look like spam — before your phone rings.
Becoming your SMS app lets SpamShield keep spam out of your inbox. Messages stay in Android\'s own store — SpamShield never copies their text.
SpamShield can\'t stop a call or text from reaching your carrier. It steps in the instant one arrives — silencing, rejecting, or moving it out of sight before it disturbs you.
Nothing blocked yet — you\'re all set.
